item.title: Roger A. Ward
item.description: Roger A. Ward was born September 18, 1940, as a member of the Munsee Tribe in Kansas, and was a lifelong resident of Ottawa until his death on February 20, 2026. He was born in Ottawa and raised by Reid and Dorothy Ward, an Ottawa couple who owned and operated a small manufacturing business. item.title: Ruth Ann Boyd
item.description: Osage City – Ruth Ann Boyd, 79, passed away on Friday, February 27, 2026, at the Healthcare Resort in Topeka, Kansas. She was born on June 4, 1946, in Columbia, South Carolina, the daughter of Curtis and Daisy (Kaufman) Churchwell. Ruth grew up in South Carolina and had lived near Osage City since 1977. Ruth worked as a cosmetologist all of her life, working as a hairdresser, massage therapist and giving facials. Her family was the center of her world.
